sloka: वालिना हृतराज्येन सुग्रीवेण महाप्रभुः ।चक्रे ऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः ।। ५.५८.१३८ ।।।।
transliteration: vālinā hṛtarājyena sugrīveṇa mahāprabhuḥ ।cakre 'gnisākṣikaṁ sakhyaṁ rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 5.58.138 ।।।।

translations.english: With fire as witness the great lord, Rama along with Lakshmana made friendship with Sugriva whose kingdom had been usurped.
